device_entry.description: 符合 IEEE 488.2 标准的通用实验室测试仪器，可通过标准公共命令完成设备识别、复位、自检、触发、状态寄存器管理以及仪器状态的保存与恢复。此类设备常见于各类台式电子测量仪器中。
device_entry.description_en: A generic laboratory test instrument compliant with the IEEE 488.2 standard. It supports standard common commands for identification, reset, self-test, triggering, status register handling, and instrument state save/recall. This device class is commonly found in bench electronic test instruments.

schema.description: 异步清除状态寄存器并清空错误队列
schema.description_en: Asynchronously clear the status registers and error queue.

schema.description: 异步从指定非易失存储位置恢复仪器状态
schema.description_en: Asynchronously recall the instrument state from the specified non-volatile memory location.

schema.description: 异步将仪器复位到出厂默认上电状态
schema.description_en: Asynchronously reset the instrument to its factory default power-up state.

schema.description: 异步将当前仪器状态保存到指定非易失存储位置
schema.description_en: Asynchronously save the current instrument state to the specified non-volatile memory location.

schema.description: 异步执行完整自检
schema.description_en: Asynchronously perform a complete self-test.

schema.description: 异步设置“操作完成”位，使当前操作结束后置位标准事件寄存器
schema.description_en: Asynchronously set the Operation Complete bit so it is asserted in the Standard Event Register when the current operation finishes.

schema.description: 异步触发仪器执行一次触发操作
schema.description_en: Asynchronously trigger the instrument to perform a trigger event.

schema.description: 异步等待前序操作完成后再继续执行
schema.description_en: Asynchronously wait for the preceding operation to complete before continuing.

schema.description: 异步等待全部挂起命令完成并返回操作完成指示
schema.description_en: Asynchronously wait until all pending commands complete and return an operation-complete indication.

schema.description: 读取仪器标识信息
schema.description_en: Read the instrument identification information.

schema.description: 读取已安装选件信息
schema.description_en: Read the installed option information.

schema.description: 将仪器复位到出厂默认上电状态
schema.description_en: Reset the instrument to its factory default power-up state.

schema.description: 执行完整自检
schema.description_en: Perform a complete self-test.

schema.description: 等待前序操作完成后再继续执行
schema.description_en: Wait for the preceding operation to complete before continuing.

schema.description: 触发仪器执行一次触发操作
schema.description_en: Trigger the instrument to perform a trigger event.

schema.description: 读取状态字节
schema.description_en: Read the status byte.

schema.description: 获取或设置服务请求使能寄存器
schema.description_en: Get or set the service request enable register.

schema.description: 读取标准事件状态寄存器
schema.description_en: Read the Standard Event Status Register.

schema.description: 获取或设置标准事件状态使能寄存器
schema.description_en: Get or set the Standard Event Status Enable Register.

schema.description: 清除状态寄存器并清空错误队列
schema.description_en: Clear the status registers and error queue.

schema.description: 等待全部挂起命令完成并返回操作完成指示
schema.description_en: Wait until all pending commands complete and return an operation-complete indication.

schema.description: 设置“操作完成”位，使当前操作结束后置位标准事件寄存器
schema.description_en: Set the Operation Complete bit so it is asserted in the Standard Event Register when the current operation finishes.

schema.description: 获取或设置上电时是否清除状态相关寄存器
schema.description_en: Get or set whether status-related registers are cleared at power-on.

schema.description: 从指定非易失存储位置恢复仪器状态
schema.description_en: Recall the instrument state from the specified non-volatile memory location.

schema.description: 将当前仪器状态保存到指定非易失存储位置
schema.description_en: Save the current instrument state to the specified non-volatile memory location.
